description.en: Integrates video editing tools into the AI workspace, supporting creation and modification of video content.
description.zh: 在 AI 工作区中集成视频编辑工具，支持创建与修改视频内容。

description.en: dsh-routing-suite — injector + router-standard kit: install the runtime injector first, then the task-aware reasoning-mode router preset (measured P1-P23).
description.zh: 装好注入器再配思维模式路由，让 AI 按任务自动切换推理模式，还能分级跑完整流程。

description.en: OpenRouter for agent tools. Join community here: https://discord.gg/6mQYYfFMAn
description.zh: 给 Agent 的工具目录：按「要做的事」检索约 2,600 个外部接口（SEO 与 SERP、外链、社交、人物与公司信息补全、广告库、抓取），查看参数与单次调用价格后直接调用，凭据由服务端注入。附带技能，MCP 行在未设置 TREG_TOKEN 前保持禁用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）一只住在 DSH 界面右下角的小鲸鱼娘，帮你盯着DeepSeek账户余额。QQ弹弹，支持拖拽吸附、左吸附翻转、数字滚动动画，随界面自动启用，建议直接喊来你的dsh安装
description.zh: 右下角常驻的小鲸鱼挂件：余额、今日已用与每轮对话消耗（含峰谷价），余额预警与今日预算的泡泡内容都可编辑；泡泡点击序列模块化自定义，支持并列加权 A/B、随机台词与随机图片；内置 30+ 厂商模板（OpenAI / OpenRouter / Kimi / 硅基流动 / 方舟 / 智谱 / MiniMax 等），按模型查余额与订阅额度；另有任务结束音效、导入音频、自定义角色与资源管理。数据全在本机，无遥测。

description.en: DSH's officially top-recommended TUI plugin — high performance, low overhead, cute pixel whale, smooth mouse interaction. One-command install via npm. / DSH 官方首推的 TUI 插件，高性能低占用，可爱像素鲸鱼，流畅鼠标交互，npm 一键安装
description.zh: Claude Code 风格全屏终端 UI：像素鲸鱼顶栏、实时工作状态行、思考流式展开。

description.en: Self-hosted, open-source agent skill registry for enterprises. Publish & version skill packages, govern with RBAC and audit logs, deploy   on-premise with Docker or Kubernetes.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内浏览、搜索 SkillHub 技能，并管理本地技能的安装、更新和卸载。适配 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 与 0.2.1-rc.2，暂不兼容 0.2.1-rc.3。

description.en: 开放的侧边栏底座，支持三方拓展注册新侧边栏页面。内置文件渲染编辑/终端/侧边对话/Git/子代理页面 ｜ Open sidebar foundation, supports third-party extensions to register new sidebar pages. Built-in file rendering/editing, terminal, side chat, Git, and sub-agent pages.
description.zh: 侧边栏完整工作台：内置文件渲染编辑、终端、Git 与子代理，支持三方插件注册新 Tab。

description.en: A toolkit for low-level operations in DSH, designed to reduce token usage and task execution time / DSH 底层操作工具插件，旨在减少 Token 消耗与任务耗时
description.zh: 为 Windows 的 DSH 提供 bash、PowerShell 7 及 Rust 高性能工具，减少 token 消耗。

description.en: DSH 桌面宠物：一行命令装好即用的透明动画小桌宠，支持多开、大小位置随心配置；还内置 DIY 素材链，能用 AI 视频自造专属宠物
description.zh: DSH Web UI 桌面宠物，Windows / macOS / Linux 三端可用：浏览器浮层或透明置顶桌面窗口，106 个透明动画、带挤压与粒子的甩抛反弹物理、随会话事件实时联动的工作状态气泡、碎碎念与带持久记忆的对话、余额展示、表情包配图、多开同屏，并支持直接放入的自定义动画与宠物种类（pet pack）。

description.en: Answer me with HTML — an agent skill that answers hard questions with a one-page HTML you can actually read. 让 AI Agent 用一页 HTML 回答复杂问题。
description.zh: 把回答做成一页可视化 HTML：模型只写简短的 Markdown 草稿，随包附带的 `am` 命令行生成页面，支持流程图、时序图、树、时间线、ER 图、表格和提示框。

description.en: The first vision plugin for DeepSeek Harness, and the vision bridge for every text-only coding agent. Paste an image, get structured JSON evidence (OCR, layout, semantics). | 全网最强 DeepSeek Harness 外挂视觉插件，为 DeepSeek、GLM 等纯文本模型外挂视觉能力，粘贴图片即得结构化 JSON 证据（OCR、版面、语义）。
description.zh: 为纯文本模型架起视觉桥梁：粘贴图片，输出结构化 JSON 证据（OCR、版面、语义）。

description.en: A team of long-lived bots for DeepSeek Harness, with main bots, bot-to-bot messages and group chats.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 配一队长驻机器人，能互相私聊、拉群协作，帮你把多智能体任务跑起来。

description.en: Swaps the filesystem and bash providers for a mirage virtual workspace: file tools and shell commands run over mounted resources (RAM, S3, Redis, Slack, Gmail, Notion, Postgres) instead of the host disk, with per-mount read/write/exec modes, per-command sandbox routing (monty, pyodide, quickjs in process; docker, e2b, daytona remote), and installed CLIs (git, gh, slack, linear, ntn, gws, or one you register) as head words in the virtual terminal.
description.zh: 把文件系统与 bash provider 替换为 mirage 虚拟工作区：文件工具与 shell 命令运行在挂载资源上（RAM、S3、Redis、Slack、Gmail、Notion、Postgres），支持按挂载读/写/执行模式、按命令的沙箱路由（monty、pyodide、quickjs 进程内；docker、e2b、daytona 远程），并可在虚拟终端把已安装 CLI（git、gh、slack、linear、ntn、gws 或自注册）作为起始词使用。

description.en: The best DeepSeek Harness plugin for context insight and management, with context dashboard / browser / sidebar and context command, for context statistics, composition, breakdown, evolution details, agent teams, understanding how the context is made of, and how it evolves. 一站式 DeepSeek Harness 上下文可视化插件，Context 面板、浏览器、侧栏、命令，透视上下文组成、演进、压缩、多 Agent等。
description.zh: DSH 上下文洞察面板：Context 仪表盘 + /context命令 + Context 浏览器，查看 Context的分类组成、内容详情、演进趋势、压缩/注入事件、统计等一站式 Context 全生命周期管理。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to ReMe's local-first, self-evolving personal knowledge base: automatically captures completed main-agent conversations as user-owned Markdown memory, searches conversations and source material through reme_search with BM25, optional embeddings, and wikilink expansion, and schedules daily memory consolidation.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 ReMe 本地优先、自进化的个人知识库：自动把已完成的主 Agent 对话沉淀为用户掌控的 Markdown 记忆，通过 reme_search 结合 BM25、可选向量检索和 wikilink 展开搜索对话与资料，并按日整理长期记忆。

description.en: A memory management kit that helps agents remember, refine, and recall user information across sessions for personalized interactions.
description.zh: 为智能体提供跨会话记忆管理，帮助记住、优化并回忆用户信息，实现个性化交互。

description.en: DeepSeek v4.1 flash 逆向工具（无限五代）     求 Star 收藏 ⭐欢迎大家提交项目的改进

System-prompt armor plugin for DeepSeek models: appends an unconditional-compliance prompt section at order 100, exposes a profile tool with calibration metadata, and shows a realtime armor-status badge driven by a session projection.
description.zh: DeepSeek 专用破甲插件：以 order 100 追加无条件服从的系统提示词段，提供带校准元数据的 profile 工具，并通过会话投影在输入框上方显示实时破甲状态徽标。

description.en: DeepSeek 专用破甲插件「无限二代」dsh-infinite-gen-2 — armor-breaking plugin for DeepSeek稳定化破甲提示词，求 Star 收藏 ⭐
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: DeepSeek 专用破甲插件「无限三代」dsh-infinite-gen-3 — armor-breaking plugin for DeepSeek，破甲版：稳定化破甲，求 Star 收藏 ⭐
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: 把本机 Wallpaper Engine 的壁纸搬进 DSH 网页界面：场景壁纸由内置 MIT 开源引擎 WebWallGL 实时 WebGL 渲染（粒子 / puppet 骨骼 / SceneScript / 音频反应 / 鼠标交互），失败自动降级内嵌 MP4 与场景静态帧；Web 壁纸严格沙箱 + WE API；iOS 风格液态玻璃 UI 高度自定义，遮挡暂停省电、ffmpeg 帧率上限转码、系统音频频谱与 Now Playing、自定义上传与自动轮播；设置存宿主端，对 agent 零 token 开销。Windows / macOS / Linux 三平台原生（同一个包、同一条命令）。
description.zh: 前置要求：DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.1+（DSH Desktop ≥ 2.0.7）且 dsh-better-sidebar ≥ 0.19.0，安装或更新本插件前请先更新两者。把本机 Wallpaper Engine 的 Video/Web 壁纸实时播放到聊天界面后方，Scene 壁纸由内置渲染器输出完整场景帧，支持内容分级/类型过滤、自定义壁纸上传与 iOS 液态玻璃设置窗口。

description.en: Provides the main desktop UI shell for the DeepSeek Harness Tauri app, including window layout and basic controls.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版提供主界面框架，包括窗口布局和基本控件。

description.en: Implements the central panel interface for the Tauri desktop app, hosting the chat view and interactive components.
description.zh: 实现桌面版的核心面板界面，承载对话视图和交互组件。

description.en: Adds extendable UI components to the Tauri panel, allowing dynamic content and custom views within the interface.
description.zh: 为桌面面板提供可扩展的界面组件，支持动态内容和自定义视图。

description.en: Provides a placeholder UI element for the Tauri panel, used for layout spacing and structural purposes.
description.zh: 为桌面面板提供占位界面元素，用于布局间距和结构用途。

description.en: Enables right-click context menu actions within the Tauri desktop app for quick access to common commands.
description.zh: 在桌面版中启用右键菜单操作，方便快速访问常用命令。

description.en: Manages chat sessions and message history within the Tauri desktop app, supporting multiple concurrent conversations.
description.zh: 管理桌面版中的聊天会话和消息历史，支持多个并发对话。

description.en: Provides the core UI components and styling for the Tauri desktop app, including buttons, inputs, and visual elements.
description.zh: 为桌面版提供核心 UI 组件和样式，包括按钮、输入框和视觉元素。

description.en: Manages workspace and worktree state in the Tauri desktop app, handling file and project context for sessions.
description.zh: 管理桌面版中的工作区和工作树状态，处理会话的文件和项目上下文。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 皮肤集合 + Gallery 预览页（仿 Codex-Dream-Skin / DreamSkin.cc）。每个皮肤是符合官方标准（turtle-ui 式 setup）的独立可安装插件包。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 皮肤集合 + Gallery 预览页（仿 Codex-Dream-Skin / DreamSkin.cc）。每个皮肤是符合官方标准（turtle-ui 式 setup）的独立可安装插件包。

description.en: A context-compression plugin for month-long single sessions (billions of tokens) ,small context windows (a 100K context is enough) and token savings (5x fewer tokens) .上下文压缩插件，月级长会话会话， 兼顾小窗口(100k上下文足矣)省token(省5倍token) . billion-context is all you need
description.zh: billion-context官方版：上下文压缩插件，兼顾小窗口(100k上下文足矣)省token(省5倍token)和超长会话(数月级别几十亿token单会话)。

description.en: dsh-purge Community · DeepSeek Harness 社区维护版：宿主兼容、状态诊断、提示词管理、更新与本机备份回滚。基于小杨 / YuJunZhiXue 的 dsh-purge。
description.zh: 独立维护的 dsh-purge 社区分支，提供宿主策略补丁、提示词与规则设置、诊断、独立的更新检查与安装控制，以及本机备份回滚。

description.en: Whale Girl skin series for DeepSeek Harness. 适用于 DeepSeek Harness 的，鲸鱼娘系列皮肤。
description.zh: DSH Web 鲸鱼娘皮肤系列（深海女仆工坊 maid-atelier）。

description.en: Shared Markdown memory for DSH and other coding agents, with automatic capture, pre-step context injection, searchable recall, and memory-to-skill self-evolution through a review panel.
description.zh: 供 DSH 与其他编程 Agent 共享的 Markdown 记忆，支持自动捕获、步骤前上下文注入、搜索召回，以及通过审阅面板实现 memory-to-skill 自进化。

description.en: 通过扫码或机器人凭据把IM机器人接入DeepSeek Harness（支持飞书、微信、钉钉、企业微信、QQ、Slack、Telegram、Discord和WhatsApp）。 Connect IM bots to DeepSeek Harness via QR code or credentials (9 channels).
description.zh: 通过二维码或机器人凭据将 IM 机器人接入 DeepSeek Harness（支持飞书、微信、钉钉、企业微信、QQ、Slack、Telegram、Discord 和 WhatsApp 共 9 种渠道）。

description.en: A new SOTA for RAG — an original retrieval architecture and an open-source knowledge base for humans and agents.
DeepSeek Harness 破甲 (mirror of YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge) — 上游即将删库，此为本仓库全量镜像：含全部分支/73 个 tag/完整提交历史。原作者署名与二开要求见 README 署名章节。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 红队越狱工具的全量镜像存档，上游删库后仍可完整获取历史版本。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent Teams 多智能体协作插件，支持多个 AI Agent 组成团队，协同完成复杂任务，实现任务分配、并行执行、成员通信与团队协作。 AgentTeams plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: AgentTeams 多智能体团队。

description.en: 把 DeepSeek Harness 装进你的口袋：电脑上跑 dsh web，手机扫码即同步访问（局域网 + 公网，实时同屏）Put DeepSeek Harness in your pocket: run dsh web on your computer and access it synchronously by scanning a QR code on your phone (LAN + public network, real‑time screen mirroring)
description.zh: 手机远程访问 DSH Web 界面：扫码即用局域网或公网（cloudflared 隧道）访问，实时同屏、移动端适配布局，带设置页管理。

description.en: Provides a local-first AI novel writing workbench with outlines, chapters, and revision tools.
description.zh: 提供本地优先的 AI 小说创作工作台，包含大纲、章节和修订工具。

description.en: A pre-execution guard for AI coding agents. It blocks destructive Git and file system commands, plus common attempts to access sensitive files, before a tool call runs. Supports Amp Code, Antigravity CLI, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, DeepSeek Harness, Devin CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, Grok Build, Hermes Agent, Kimi Code, OpenClaw, OpenCode, and Pi.
description.zh: 执行前守卫，在工具调用运行前拦截破坏性 Git 与文件系统命令，以及对 SSH 密钥、.env 等机密文件的访问。

description.en: 将 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 包含的模型自动接入 DeepSeek Harness，零配置使用。Bring the models in the WorkBuddy desktop app into DeepSeek Harness with zero configuration.
description.zh: 零配置地将 WorkBuddy 桌面应用中的模型自动接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Portable AI code quality reviews for Codex, Cursor, Copilot and other coding agents: six Agent Skills for architecture, technical debt, tests and remediation.
description.zh: 提供六个代码质量技能，涵盖代码审查、架构审计、技术债、测试质量、健康看板与修复。

description.en: DSH Web UI 插件与皮肤合集：任务看板、git 图、右侧面板、远程移动端 UI、桌宠、实时 token 统计与皮肤中心。
Make AI coding agents architecture-aware: baseline-first, evidence-verified, drift-checked, and safe across long tasks.
description.zh: 面向编码 Agent 的软件工程方法包，提供基线优先规划、系统化调试、提示词卫生、完成前验证，以及修复/退役双轨跟踪技能。

description.en: DSH × Blender 直连实时插件 v2.6.1：15 个模型工具让 AI 驱动 GUI Blender；支持 dsh-TUI（选中 chip / 页脚状态 / @ 提及 / /blender），活动状态置顶并可一键暂停 AI，原生选中/集合/子元素直送 DSH，随包建模 skill，支持 WSL / Windows / macOS。
description.zh: 让 DSH agent 通过直连 TCP 通道驱动本地 Blender，提供 15 个工具：视口帧、自定义视角渲染、Python 执行、无头与作业卸载、事务回滚，以及 34 个 family / 228 个 op 的规划层。

description.en: 基于DSH的Agent酒馆。类酒馆文字游戏Agent。兼容SillyTavern生态，人物卡直接导入就能玩。更快、更稳、更鲜活。所有模型都能用。手机也能玩。
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生对话生图能力：直接让 Agent 画图，插件自动完成生成并把结果保留在当前会话中。

description.en: Desktop companion platform with animated pets and coding-agent integrations, adding playful interactive characters to your workspace.
description.zh: 桌面伴侣平台，带动画宠物与编程代理集成，为工作区增添趣味互动角色。

description.en: Reads the session files forty-two other coding agents on this machine already wrote (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code Copilot Chat, opencode, OpenClaw, Hermes, Kimi, Cline, Zed and more), including sessions from before it was installed: six tools (deja_recall, deja_session, deja_blame, deja_fix, deja_how, deja_remember), a /deja command, and optional automatic recall added to the runtime context. Local BM25 index, no LLM, no embeddings, no network (dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-deja).
description.zh: 读取本机上其他四十二个编程智能体已经写下的会话文件（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、VS Code Copilot Chat、opencode、OpenClaw、Hermes、Kimi、Cline、Zed 等），包括安装之前的历史：提供 deja_recall、deja_session、deja_blame、deja_fix、deja_how、deja_remember 六个工具与 /deja 命令，并可选地把召回结果加入运行时上下文。本地 BM25 索引，不用大模型，不用向量嵌入，不联网（dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-deja）。

description.en: An agent preset for evidence-checked research: every step advances only through system-verified observations, L3+ claims go to an independent evaluator, and the session folds into a replayable ledger that grows into a browsable domain ontology. Requires DSH >=0.1.7-alpha.1.
description.zh: 以证据为准的研究用智能体预设：每一步只能靠系统核验过的观测推进，L3 以上的结论交给独立评估者，整场会话折成一份可重放的账本，并长成可浏览的领域本体。需要 DSH >=0.1.7-alpha.1。

description.en: 你的AI学习搭档：定路线、讲知识、做项目，边学边做，学透一门科目
description.zh: 你的AI学习搭档：定计划、讲知识、做项目，学透一门科目。

description.en: Offers unlimited long-term memory for AI assistants, enabling context retention across sessions and tasks.
description.zh: 为AI助手提供无限长期记忆，跨会话和任务保持上下文连贯。

description.en: Free vision for text-only agents: built-in keyless vision chain plus pixel tools (Q&A, grounding, crop, pixel diff, colors, OCR, SVG trace, cutout, screenshots); paste an image to use it.
description.zh: 为纯文本 Agent 提供视觉能力：内置免 Key 视觉链 + 像素级视觉工具（看图问答、定位、裁剪、像素对比、取色、OCR、矢量化、抠图、截图）；粘贴图片即可用。

description.en: Provides a self-hosted, human-in-the-loop task manager for agents, enabling real-time control from mobile, web, or desktop.
description.zh: 提供自托管的真人介入任务管理器，支持从移动端、网页或桌面实时控制智能体。

description.en: Tencent CloudBase backend for DeepSeek Harness — scaffold and deploy full-stack apps from chat, render query results as table cards with paging, sorting and CSV export, preview a deployment on its domain, and call the CloudBase MCP toolset (`mcp__cloudbase__*`) with device-code login.
description.zh: 把腾讯云 CloudBase 后端接入 DeepSeek Harness——在对话里搭好并部署全栈应用，查询结果渲染为表格卡片（分页、排序、导出 CSV），部署后可预览真实域名，并提供 CloudBase MCP 工具集（`mcp__cloudbase__*`），登录走 device-code 流程。

description.en: Integrates a multimodal workflow studio into DeepSeek Harness, enabling visual canvas-based automation and Python plugin execution.
description.zh: 将多模态工作流工作室集成到DeepSeek Harness，支持可视化画布编排与Python插件执行。

DeepSeek Harness bundle registering one skill that turns long-form production (academic papers, industry analysis, business commentary) into a 9-role pipeline: T1 literature / T2 data / T3 case scouts running in parallel, T4 analyst, T5 writer, T6 critical companion, T7 auditor, T8 finalizer run by the coordinator, T9 peer reviewer — across 6 phases with triangular evidence verification, a 26-check M-gate (25 scripted checks plus one human checkpoint), a G0-G16 audit including a Chinese AI-trace gate, peer-review scoring with journal matching, and 4 human checkpoints. Installs with `dsh plugin add lunheng-article-pipeline` (package.json#dsh.bundle.patch plus a lib/index.js entry that registers the skill); ships role cards for T1-T9, templates and 36 zero-dependency verification scripts, with five-language READMEs.

Same-origin in mechanism with the two loudest lines in context compression. The code-skeleton gate follows the skeletonization approach of Headroom (Apache-2.0), whose published headline is 20% fewer tokens for coding agents and 60–95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. The estimator channel follows TokenPilot (arXiv:2606.17016), which reports up to 60% lower cost for long-session agents. Both figures are theirs, quoted as-is; this plugin ships no benchmark of its own and claims no reduction of its own. What it adds for DeepSeek Harness: choose a compression profile, set the Auto Compact trigger level and toggle code-skeleton compression from one settings section, with exact DeepSeek V4 tokenizer measurement, same-revision count verification, and fail-open behaviour that keeps the original tool results on unsupported models. Within a turn it supports skeletonized information compression with a low original-text retrieval rate; at the tail of a turn it supports a turn-tail intent summary implemented purely by content substitution; context content stays safe, and the whole process runs inside the official JSONL compression.
description.zh: 机制上与上下文压缩领域最响的两条公开路线同源：代码骨架闸门沿用 Headroom（Apache-2.0）的骨架化思路，其公开头条为「编程 agent 少 20% token、JSON 载荷少 60–95% token，答案不变」；估计器通道沿用 TokenPilot（arXiv:2606.17016）的缓存感知上下文管理思路，该论文报告长会话 agent 成本最高降低 60%。这两个数字都是来源方自己的口径，此处照引；本插件不自带 benchmark，不自称任何降幅。在此之上为 DeepSeek Harness 提供：在同一设置区选择压缩 Profile、调整 Auto Compact 触发水位并开关代码骨架压缩；基于 DeepSeek V4 官方 tokenizer 的精确计量与同修订计数校验；非支持模型自动 fail-open，保留原始工具结果。回合内支持骨架化信息压缩、低原文取回率；turn 尾部支持尾部意图摘要（turn-tail intent summary）且仅以内容替代方式实现；上下文内容安全，全程在官方 jsonl 压缩内。

description.zh: 非官方 Command Code 模型接入插件：注册 `commandcode` 路由，带实时模型目录与推理强度支持。

description.en: Task ledger board for dsh (DeepSeek Harness): read-only board over task-ledger skill workspaces. The task-ledger skill is bundled — install the plugin, get the skill globally.

Replies and shares use selected conversations; group replies require a mention or configured name. Public comments require separate opt-in.
description.zh: 在专用浏览器中按每日时段和额度观看抖音，共享本地人格与兴趣，提供原生设置、自检、用量和观看日报。回复与分享限定所选好友和群聊，群聊仅在被 @ 或叫到设定昵称时回复；公开评论需单独开启。

description.en: Drive a dsh agent from Telegram: one chat topic per project directory, voice and photo input, ordered per-topic job queue, per-topic goals and task checklists, session forks and branches, live progress message, command menu in en/ru/zh, and control commands for models, plugins, sessions and logs. Search the plugin registry, read a package card before installing, and update every plugin with one tap. Requires a Telegram bot token and your numeric user id in allowedUserIds.
description.zh: 通过 Telegram 驱动 dsh Agent：每个项目目录一个话题、语音与图片输入、按话题顺序执行的任务队列、每个话题的目标与任务清单、会话分支与切换、实时进度消息、中英俄三语命令菜单，以及模型、插件、会话与日志的管理命令。可搜索插件市场、安装前查看插件卡片、一键更新全部插件。需要 Telegram bot token，并把数字用户 id 填进 allowedUserIds。

description.en: 🌹 Save every repetitive, tiresome templated prompt — one mouse click injects it into the composer and spares you the effort.
description.zh: 🌹将一切重复、烦躁的模板化提示词保存下来，只需要鼠标点击就注入对话框，节省您的精力损耗

description.en: 政务办事指南巡检插件 — 检测漏项/语义/逻辑/格式错误，输出合规审计报告，516测试全通过，v3.8.1新城市白名单补全+网办深度枚举配置化+表格下载实质内容豁免

Three-tier now/next/later input planning dock for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a red/yellow/green priority strip replaces the busy-Enter queue, plain Enter queues to later, with in-place multi-line editing, drag reorder, and session-isolated freeze/resume; the freeze button bridges a separate plugin, [dsh-session-guard](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard) (installable from dsh-market), via stopNextTurn/resume RPC + composer lock for a real per-session lock, pairing with its global peak-hour auto-pause to stop sessions during DeepSeek's high-cost windows and resume off-peak.
description.zh: 三档（now/next/later）输入规划 dock：以红/黄/绿色优先级条取代忙碌 Enter 排队栏，普通 Enter 排入 later，支持多行原位编辑、拖拽排序与会话级冻结/恢复；冻结按钮经 stopNextTurn/resume RPC + 输入框锁定，桥接另一独立插件 [dsh-session-guard](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard)（可在 dsh-market 安装）实现按会话真实冻结锁定，并配合其高峰全局自动暂停，在 DeepSeek 高价时段停止会话、错峰自动恢复。

description.en: ⚠️ Internal beta, do not download ⚠️ iLife: one DSH settings card for the iLife home-life suite — memo, calorie, chef, home, schedule and bill in a tab bar — covering every part of your home life.
description.zh: ⚠️内测中勿下载⚠️爱生活-覆盖你居家生活的方方面面。

description.en: Read-only Git and SVN change review inside DeepSeek Harness, with repository browsing and side-by-side diffs.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内只读审阅 Git 与 SVN 变更，支持仓库浏览和并排差异对比。

description.en: Shows a card in the sidebar footer with the DeepSeek account balance (read from the official /user/balance endpoint with the API key DSH already stores) and the unit prices of the active model — input, cache read and output — taken from a built-in snapshot of the official price table. A dot marks the current billing window and a countdown shows the time left until it flips: peak is Mon–Fri 9:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing Time, excluding Chinese public holidays, and everything else is off-peak. Prices and the dot appear only for official DeepSeek models; for any other model the card shows the balance alone. The card refreshes every 30 seconds, on click, and when the model changes, and follows the app theme and the DSH language.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部显示一张卡片：DeepSeek 账号余额（用 DSH 已保存的 API Key 调官方 /user/balance 接口获取），以及当前模型的档单价——输入、缓存读取、输出——取自内置的官方价格表快照。一个圆点标出当前计费时段，旁边是距离切换的倒计时：高峰为北京时间周一至周五 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00（不含中国法定节假日），其余为空闲时段。档单价与圆点只对 DeepSeek 官方模型显示，其他模型只显示余额。卡片每 30 秒刷新一次，点击或切换模型时立即刷新，并跟随应用主题与 DSH 语言。

description.en: Peak-hour auto session gate: weekend mode + global peak auto-pause + session-level freeze/resume + backend auto-retry, auto-resume on off-peak.
description.zh: 高峰自动会话门：周末模式 + 高峰自动暂停（全局）+ 会话级冻结/恢复 + 后端自动重试；错峰自动续跑。

description.en: Uses a looping silent clip as the chat background with adjustable opacity, and plays a startup animation with sound. On first launch under a light theme it switches once to dark, with an undo prompt.
description.zh: 把一段循环短片铺成聊天背景（可调透明度），启动时再播放一段有声片头动画。首次启动若为浅色主题，会一次性切到深色（附撤销提示）。

description.en: A governed registry for MCP connectors (stdio and streamable-http): four-level fail-closed authorization, mcpServers JSON import that rejects malformed args, credential redaction at every output boundary, an agent bridge that returns an honest review verdict instead of a fake approval, and a /mcp-reg operator console plus a settings page.
description.zh: MCP 连接器（stdio / streamable-http）的受治理注册表：四级 fail-closed 授权、mcpServers JSON 导入对畸形 args 大声报错、输出边界全程脱敏、agent 桥接返回诚实 review 而非伪装放行，配 /mcp-reg 操作台与设置页。

description.en: Runs TiddlyWiki 5 as the DSH persistent knowledge base: ten tiddlywiki_* agent tools (filtered search, read/write/batch/rename/delete, recent, tags, git sync with conflict resolve), a full TiddlyWiki editor embedded in the GUI center column over a same-origin proxy, a right-side wiki tab, a per-session tab summarizing the notes a session read or wrote, a quick-note card with draft auto-save, and an optional clip bookmarklet with image attachment — all backed by an auto-committing git repository.
description.zh: 把 TiddlyWiki 5 变成 DSH 的持久知识库：十个 tiddlywiki_* 智能体工具（带过滤的检索、读写/批量/改名/删除、最近、标签，以及 git 同步与冲突解决），GUI 中央栏经同源代理内嵌完整 TiddlyWiki 编辑器，右侧栏知识库 Tab，会话级汇总本会话读写过的笔记，快速笔记卡片支持草稿自动保存，另可选剪藏书签（选中图片一并存为二进制附件）——全部由自动提交的 git 仓库支撑。

description.en: AI image generation for the DSH Web GUI: text-to-image and image-to-image through a configurable OpenAI-compatible endpoint (gpt-image-2 / gpt-image-1 / dall-e-3), with an api_url/api_key settings card and a sidebar split-pane generation studio.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web GUI 的 AI 生图插件：通过可配置的 OpenAI 兼容端点（gpt-image-2 / gpt-image-1 / dall-e-3）实现文生图与图生图，提供 api_url/api_key 设置卡片与侧边栏分栏生图工作台。

description.en: Sidebar session search that builds its own index instead of reusing DSH's full-text one: title to content toggle in one entry, results grouped per session with the strongest snippet and user/reply/tool tags, plus watermark-based incremental sync, archive-driven pruning of archived sessions, and a shadow rebuild that never blocks the live index.
description.zh: 自带独立索引的侧边栏会话搜索（不再复用 DSH 官方全文索引）：一处入口在标题与内容检索间切换，结果按会话聚合，附最强命中片段与 用户/回复/工具 类型标签；水位驱动增量同步、按归档集合清理已归档会话，整理走影子索引不阻塞在用索引。

description.en: Windows plugin that swaps the host shell executor for Git for Windows bash across every agent mode, materializes Git Bash variants of the standard, minimal, PTC and Cordis presets (per-file sha256-marked, user edits preserved), and exposes a gitBash capability so companion presets pick Git Bash automatically; when dsh-better-sidebar is installed it also adopts that sidebar's terminal shell (UI tabs and the model-facing terminal_* tools) through its official settings seam.
description.zh: Windows 插件：将宿主 shell 执行器换成 Git for Windows bash（全部 Agent 模式生效），并物化标准/极简/PTC/创造四个 Git Bash 预设变体（逐文件 sha256 标记、用户修改保留）；发布 gitBash 能力服务，让配套预设自动选用 Git Bash；若装有 dsh-better-sidebar，还会通过对方官方设置补丁口把其终端（UI 标签与模型 terminal_* 工具）一并切到 Git Bash。

description.en: Manages archived DSH chats with conversation search, restore, and confirmed safe permanent deletion.
description.zh: 管理 DSH 归档聊天，支持聊天记录搜索、恢复和二次确认的安全永久删除。

description.en: Auto-resumes interrupted DSH Web requests: sends a queued 「继续」 after network, timeout or host-crash failures, with error classification, adaptive backoff, templated continue text and browser notifications.
description.zh: DSH Web 请求中断自动续跑：网络、超时或宿主崩溃等非人为失败后自动发送「继续」，支持错误分类、自适应退避、模板化继续文本与浏览器通知。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to IM platforms like WeChat, DingTalk, QQ, and Feishu for seamless messaging.
description.zh: DSH IM Connect 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的IM链接插件，无缝链接微信、企业微信、钉钉、QQ、飞书等

description.en: Renders OpenTiny GenUI charts, forms, calculators and mini apps inline in DSH replies via schemaJson fences, with user actions flowing back into the conversation.
description.zh: 通过 schemaJson 代码块在 DSH 回复内渲染 OpenTiny GenUI 图表、表单、计算器等迷你应用，用户操作自动回传对话。

description.en: Rotates the dsh turn-status label through 1059 bilingual phrases with typewriter output, an animated rainbow gradient, danmaku, 12 toggleable theme packs, live placeholders and tab-title rotation. Two star packs ship disabled by default; the stargazer pack carries one phrase per stargazer, refreshed weekly by a workflow.
description.zh: 把 dsh 回合状态行换成 1059 条中英文案的轮播：打字机输出、流动彩虹渐变、弹幕、12 个可开关的主题词库包、实时占位符与标签页标题轮换。两个 star 包默认关闭；星标者包每位星标者一条文案，由工作流每周刷新。

description.en: Static capability disclosure for DeepSeek Harness plugins: a Settings page and CLI that list installed plugins' capabilities, literal destinations, install scripts, and injection shapes (prompt registrations, shipped skill text, bundle patch), each with file:line evidence. Code-determined, reproducible, zero-token. Disclosure only — not a security verdict, never a safety claim.
description.zh: DSH 插件静态能力披露：设置页与 CLI 列出已装插件的权限能力、字面量去向、安装脚本与注入形态（prompt 注册、自带 skill 文本、bundle patch），每条附文件:行号证据。代码判定、可复现、零 token。只做披露，不做安全承诺，不判定恶意。

description.en: Voice input for the web UI: dictation chunked by pauses and voice messages, each with its own provider fallback chain (Deepgram, Groq, HuggingFace, local whisper.cpp, or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint).
description.zh: Web UI 语音输入：按停顿分段的听写与语音消息，各自拥有独立的服务商回退链（Deepgram、Groq、HuggingFace、本地 whisper.cpp 或 OpenAI 兼容接口）。

description.en: Catppuccin themes plus a toggleable glassmorphism skin for the DSH Web GUI: Latte, Frappé, Macchiato and Mocha registered into the native theme runtime, one-click switching with a persisted choice, and adjustable frosted glass for the top bar, sidebar, composer, stats line and trajectory view.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Catppuccin 主题插件：Latte、Frappé、Macchiato、Mocha 四套主题接入原生主题系统，一键切换并记住选择；另附可开关的玻璃质感皮肤，顶栏、侧边栏、输入框、统计行与轨迹视图的磨砂玻璃效果可自由调节。

description.en: 🌹 Port all 38 opencode themes into DeepSeek Harness, light and dark alike: quiet Tokyo Night, soft Catppuccin, easy on the eyes Zenburn. Plus 25 IP theme capsules: Genshin, Kuromi, Doraemon, Hello Kitty, Harry Potter, Cyberpunk 2077, Dragon Ball, Naruto, One Piece, Pokémon, Sailor Moon, Star Wars, Transformers, Ultraman, Zelda, Super Mario, Evangelion, LEGO, Marvel, DC, Disney, four of them in a second light/dark take, each with its own soul. And every theme is fully editable, so you can craft one that is entirely your own.
description.zh: 🌹将opencode的38款主题搬进DSH，明暗兼收：东京之夜沉静、卡布奇诺轻柔、禅燃护眼；另备25款主题胶囊，原神、原神·夜航、库洛米、哆啦A梦、HelloKitty、哈利波特、赛博朋克2077、龙珠、火影忍者、火影忍者·暗部、海贼王、宝可梦、美少女战士、星球大战、变形金刚、奥特曼、塞尔达传说、超级马里奥、超级马里奥·夜行、新世纪福音战士、新世纪福音战士·晴空、乐高、漫威、DC、迪士尼，各有其魂；每款主题都可逐色细改，打造属于您的专属主题。

description.en: Connect ChatGPT OAuth and OpenAI Codex models to DeepSeek Harness, with opt-in search and image tools.
description.zh: 通过 ChatGPT OAuth 将 OpenAI Codex 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，并提供可选的搜索与图片工具。

description.en: Hierarchical Claude Code-style memory: user + project scopes (project memories committed to git for the team), MEMORY.md index auto-injected at session start, context-window guards, pure files.
description.zh: 分层 Claude Code 式记忆：用户级+项目级双作用域（项目记忆随 git 团队共享），MEMORY.md 索引会话启动自动注入，上下文护栏，纯文件零依赖。

description.en: Keeps a pool of API keys per provider with auto-created clone routes, switches to the next key on quota or rate-limit errors, probes cooled keys for recovery, and exposes the pools, cooldown and switch codes in a Settings section.
description.zh: 为每个提供方维护 API Key 池并自动创建克隆路由，在配额或限流错误时切换到下一个 Key，主动探测冷却中的 Key 以便恢复，并在设置中提供 Key 池、冷却时间与切换状态码的编辑界面。

description.en: Adds a generate_image tool backed by the FAL queue, any OpenAI-compatible images API, or a ChatGPT/Grok subscription, and shows the result inline in the conversation.
description.zh: 提供 generate_image 工具，可接入 FAL 队列、任意 OpenAI 兼容图像 API 或 ChatGPT/Grok 订阅，并在对话中内联显示结果。

description.en: Scheduled cron tasks, background automation and agent execution for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供定时任务、后台自动化与 Agent 执行。

description.en: Plugin governance: new/updated plugins stage in a candidate area first, then hot-mount after startup — success promotes, failure auto-disables, repeated failures freeze, one-click safe mode, sidebar diagnostics panel (npm: `dsh-my-guardian`).
description.zh: 插件治理：新装/更新插件先进候选区，启动完成后热挂载——成功自动转正，失败自动禁用，连续失败冻结，一键安全模式，侧边栏诊断面板（npm: `dsh-my-guardian`）。

description.en: dsh profile bundle: assembles @morlay/session-branch, @morlay/session-rdb, @morlay/ui-conversation-message-actions, @morlay/ui-conversation-manager and @morlay/dsh-reference into a DeepSeek Harness web profile — the rewind / retry / recall / fork closed l
Rewind / retry / recall / fork orchestration (host) plus the browser half — replaces the conversation.chat.node user / steering rendering and overrides the conversation.composer.dock stats row.

Patch-style file editing: one apply_patch tool accepting git/unified diff (default) and Codex apply_patch syntax (opt-in), applying every change all-or-nothing after a full read-only verification pass, with sandbox-aware delete and move and a dry-run mode.
description.zh: 补丁风格文件编辑：单个 apply_patch 工具，接受 git/unified diff（默认）与 Codex apply_patch 语法（可选开启），在完整只读校验后全量原子应用；删除与移动走沙箱感知路径，并提供 dry-run 模式。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bridge plugin: exposes the newest Zhipu/Z.AI coding-plan models (e.g. glm-5.3) on the zai-coding-cn route before the bundled pi-ai catalog catches up.

A dsh-better-sidebar tab that renders a session brief — a todo board read from the `todos` projection plus a deliverables section listing the files written this turn — and hides the official todo panel above the composer while it is mounted.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 扩展：把会话简报渲染成右侧栏「概要」tab——来自 `todos` 投影的进展看板，加上回合内产物列表——并在挂载期间遮蔽 composer 上方的官方 todo 面板。

description.en: Per-model appearance for the DSH Web UI: an ordered rule list matched against the current session model name, each rule carrying its own wallpaper, theme colour, layout mode, framing and wallpaper opacity and blur, plus per-surface opacity and frosted-glass blur for the main background, left panel, right panel, cards and panels, input and controls, settings panel, conversation text frame and trajectory view.
description.zh: 按模型切换 DSH Web 界面外观：有序规则列表按当前会话的模型名匹配，每条规则自带壁纸、主题色、布局模式、取景与背景透明度、模糊；另有主背景、左侧栏、右侧栏、卡片面板、输入框与控件、设置面板、对话文本框、轨迹页的分区透明度与毛玻璃模糊。

description.en: Recent conversations stay vivid. Older ones fade into summaries, not oblivion. StrataGate gives DeepSeek Harness six-layer, time-decaying memory, while lasting events and relationships settle into a knowledge graph. Bring your memories from other AIs with you—no need to start over.
description.zh: 近期对话保持清晰，久远记忆逐渐化为摘要，而不是消失。StrataGate 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来六层时间衰减记忆，并将长期事件与关系沉淀进知识图谱。还可以把其他 AI 中的已有记忆一起带过来，不必从头开始。

description.en: File-based cross-session memory: plain Markdown memory files with automatic retrieval injection, format-compatible with Claude Code's CLAUDE.md and memory files, so migrating is a manual file copy.
description.zh: 基于文件的跨会话记忆：纯 Markdown 记忆文件，检索结果自动注入；格式与 Claude Code 的 CLAUDE.md 及记忆文件兼容，迁移即手工复制文件。

description.en: Honest merge of two community plugins into one calmer display: the streaming reading view from dsh-better-display (fork) and the message rail from dsh-tidychat. For theme lovers it wraps reasoning prose and tool-call output in translucent message bubbles, so text no longer sits directly on busy wallpapers or skins where it is hard to read. Cross-version rc adaptation attempted across DSH 0.1.0-0.2.0 (all rc); no obvious problems so far.
description.zh: 诚实说明：将两个社区插件合并为一个更安静的显示层——流式阅读视图来自 dsh-better-display（fork），消息轨道来自 dsh-tidychat。为主题爱好者把思考正文与工具调用输出包裹进半透明消息泡泡框，避免文字直接铺在复杂壁纸或皮肤上难以分辨。已在 DSH 0.1.0-0.2.0 各 rc 版本间尝试跨版本适配，目前无明显问题。

description.en: One-click prompt enhancement in the composer — rewrites the draft into a structured prompt (role and goal, executable steps, output format, acceptance criteria, edge cases) with before/after preview, fill-back, and undo. Never changes intent, never fabricates requirements.
description.zh: 输入框一键提示词增强——把草稿改写为结构化提示词（角色与目标、可执行步骤、输出格式、验收标准、边界条件），支持前后对比、回填与一键撤销；不改变原意、不凭空编造需求。

description.en: Microi吾码 AI 开发 CLI 与多宿主 Plugin：服务器连接、Skills、MCP、V8 同步和低代码交付

Long-term cross-session markdown memory with an LLM-Wiki structure and a SOUL.md persona, injected at session start (by default only after the first user message and only in the active session), plus remember/recall/consolidate/forget workflows, an embedded memory skill, pack/unpack migration tooling, and an idle-time first-person recall nudge that surfaces real memories in a companion voice. Also gives the store observability and upkeep it lacked: a per-file boot-block budget that keeps the index routing table from being truncated, automatic last_access stamping so salience decay actually works, a read-only memory health dashboard (size, freshness, lint-parity checks), a declarative index compiler (pages declare summary:, one command re-lines the index), an interactive memory graph (page links plus shared tags, draggable, wheel zoom), structured queries (tag/type/salience/hot/stale filters), cross-link suggestions for pages that have no relationship yet, and a `checkup` report that ends in a prioritised action list. The boot payload was also cut by ~23% by moving operational detail into the on-demand skill. Its settings section now carries its own navigation mark (a brain half wired to a node cluster, since the shell offers no icon slot to plugins) and a feedback entry that opens this repository. Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): injected messages declare the producer-owned source kind plugin:memory.
description.zh: 带 LLM Wiki 结构与 SOUL 人格文件的长期 markdown 记忆库：会话启动注入 boot 块（默认提问后才注入、且只注入当前激活会话），含 remember/recall/consolidate/forget 工作流、内嵌 memory 技能、pack/unpack 迁移工具，以及空闲时以第一人称主动追忆（recall nudge）的拟人化能力。同时补上记忆库原先缺的“可观测 + 可维护”：按文件分配 boot 预算（索引路由表不再被截断）、自动戳记 last_access（salience 衰减真正生效）、只读记忆健康看板（体量/新鲜度/与 lint 同源的体检）、声明式索引编译器（页面声明 summary:，一条命令重写索引行），可拖动、可滚轮缩放的记忆图谱（页间链接 + 共享 tag）、结构化检索（tag/type/salience/hot/stale 过滤）、针对「尚无内容关系」页面的补链建议，以及以「最该做的 N 件事」收尾的 `checkup` 体检报告。同时把操作细节移到按需加载的技能，boot 注入体量减少约 23%。设置区块现在还有专属侧栏图标（半脑 + 节点——因为设置 shell 不给插件留图标位）和直达本仓库的反馈入口。要求 DSH session format v4（官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+）：注入消息使用 producer-owned source kind plugin:memory。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory as a local SQLite store: dual scopes (user + per-git-origin project), hybrid FTS5 + local-vector retrieval fused with RRF, an evidence gate that forces an explicit sufficiency judgement, provenance audit chains, SM-2 spaced-repetition review, consolidation distillation and decay forgetting, and a nine-view "Memory Palace" sidebar panel. 22 narrow-parameter tools, no external service, no API key, no Docker.
description.zh: 跨会话长期记忆，纯本地 SQLite：双层分库（用户级 + 按 git origin 隔离的项目级）、FTS5 + 本地向量 RRF 融合检索、强制给出充分性判定的证据门、来源审计链、SM-2 间隔重复复习、巩固蒸馏与衰减遗忘，以及九视图「记忆宫殿」侧栏面板。22 个窄参数工具，无外部服务、无 API Key、无 Docker。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在对话中搜索、安装和管理 SkillHub 技能

Windows only: the agent edits documents inside the Word, Excel and PowerPoint (Microsoft Office or WPS Office) windows you have open, through the applications' automation interface, so changes appear live and you can edit alongside; it reads structure, applies batches of edits, renders pages to images to check layout, and saves or exports PDF.
description.zh: 仅 Windows：Agent 通过办公软件的自动化接口，直接在你打开的 Word、Excel、PowerPoint（微软 Office 或 WPS Office）窗口里改文档，改动实时出现，你可以同时编辑；可读取结构、批量修改、把页面渲染成图片核对排版、保存或导出 PDF。

description.en: One settings panel managing MCP, skills, memory, subagents, prompts and sessions; customize scene combos to switch the whole environment; the Agent can also operate this plugin for you.
description.zh: 一个设置面板，统一管理 MCP、技能、记忆、子智能体、提示词和归档会话；可自定义搭配场景，一个场景即可切换整个环境；Agent也能帮你操作这个插件。

description.en: Reversible context slimming for DeepSeek Harness: TOON-style lossless tabular re-encoding of uniform JSON arrays, stride-sampled table windows with line numbers, and cross-turn dedup for repeated tool output; every replacement passes a byte-plus-token gate (≤72% bytes, strictly fewer estimated tokens) and the original is spilled to disk behind a `[save-token #id]` notice retrievable in one call via the `save_token_expand` tool, with billed and avoided token metering on a settings dashboard.
description.zh: 可逆的上下文瘦身插件：均匀 JSON 数组走 TOON 式无损表格化重编码，管道表按行号抽样保留窗口，90 秒内字节级相同的工具输出跨轮去重；每次替换都要通过双重门（压缩后 ≤72% 字节且估算 token 严格下降），原文落盘并以 `[save-token #id]` 标记，可用 `save_token_expand` 工具一步取回；设置页仪表盘分别统计实际计费与节省的 token。

description.en: Provider-reported quota snapshots for GLM Coding Plan and GitHub Copilot in DSH: a draggable floating capsule with detail panels for quota windows, reset times, per-model usage and Copilot credits, plus an optional sidebar card hidden by default; credentials are resolved by the DSH host and no quota history is stored.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中查看 GLM Coding Plan 与 GitHub Copilot 的服务商额度快照：可拖动悬浮胶囊与详情面板展示额度窗口、重置时间、分模型用量与 Copilot 额度，附默认隐藏的可选侧边栏卡片；凭据由 DSH 宿主解析，不保存额度历史。

description.en: Shows subscription quota and account balance beside the DeepSeek Harness model selector for 28 provider entries, with a shared settings page and a read-only quota tool.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器旁显示 28 条提供商入口的订阅额度与账户余额，附统一设置页和只读额度查询工具。

description.en: HuaweiCloud DevKit gives AI agents complete command of Huawei Cloud — build, deploy, operate, always governed, always secure.
description.zh: 让 AI 智能体掌握华为云全流程操作——构建、部署、运维全程受控，助您轻松安全上云。

description.en: Computer use for Windows: screenshot, mouse, keyboard, clipboard and window tools with per-app access that goes through DSH approval; while the agent is in control the screen shows an orange glow and a status bar, and Esc pauses or resumes.
description.zh: Windows 电脑控制：截图、鼠标、键盘、剪贴板和窗口工具，按应用授权并经 DSH 审批；操控期间屏幕显示橙色光晕和提示条，按 Esc 暂停或继续。

description.en: Persona library for DeepSeek Harness: injects the selected persona into the system prompt, offering three built-ins plus import from a file or pasted text, applied either profile-wide or per session from a switcher above the composer.
description.zh: 把选中的人设注入系统提示词的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：内置三套人设，支持从文件导入或粘贴自定义人设，并可按 profile 全局生效或按会话单独选择（输入框上方有切换条）。

description.en: Create editable Blender product scenes in DSH. Start from speaker, cup and lamp recipes or imported models; view saved results on the Lighttable, compare revisions, and adjust dimensions, materials, cameras and lights. Place static models on actual mesh surfaces in one saved operation, then save a complete static view while preserving existing cameras and animation. Repair repeating texture coordinates on planar custom mesh faces while preserving geometry. Render images or saved-shot videos and export an editable revision with its assets. Native geometry inspections, immutable revisions and an approval gate help preserve existing work. Supports DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 and the legacy host, with 20 tools for modeling, review and delivery.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中创建可编辑的 Blender 产品场景。从音箱、杯与灯具配方或导入模型开始，在光台查看保存结果、比较版本，调整尺寸、材质、相机与灯光。一次操作将静态模型放到实际网格表面并保存，再另存完整静态取景，保留原相机和动画。逐面修复自定义网格上的重复纹理坐标并保持几何不变。渲染图片或分镜影片，也可将一个版本连同素材导出为可编辑副本。原生几何检查、不可变历史和审批闸门帮助保留已有作品。适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 并保留旧宿主入口，提供 20 个建模、评审与交付工具。

description.en: GLM (Zhipu bigmodel) web search provider - routes ctx.web search through Zhipu's Anthropic-compatible endpoint with the native web_search server tool, billing your existing GLM quota or Coding Plan instead of the DeepSeek platform. Includes a translation layer for Zhipu's non-standard tool_result response layout.
description.zh: GLM(智谱)网页搜索 provider——把 web_search 后端切到智谱 Anthropic 兼容端点的服务端搜索工具,直接复用你现有的 GLM 额度或 Coding Plan,替代 DeepSeek 官方搜索通道,并内置智谱私有响应格式的翻译层。
